reference.code:
package solution
func ClampedSlice(t string,s,e int)string{r:=[]rune(t);n:=len(r);if s<0{s+=n};if e<0{e+=n};if s<0{s=0};if e<0{e=0};if s>n{s=n};if e>n{e=n};if s>e{return ""};return string(r[s:e])}
